code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, monocytosis and basophilia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, D-dimer, ferritin, LDH), and a prolonged INR. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and impaired oxygenation, which may be seen in severe infection or inflammatory states. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
